verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent is documented to work on the same tracked issues humans handle, and to "gather internal context for your team". The issue log also lets humans inspect the steps the AI took, so a human picking up the issue plausibly sees the conversation and gathered context. None of this is documented as an explicit escalation handoff. Missing for 10: a documented agent-to-human escalation flow, an auto-generated handoff summary at escalation (the only AI summaries cited are for the Salesforce sync), and structured collected-details capture so the customer never repeats themselves, plus any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves

citations.quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.
Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work
